record.dic_text:
05752 `Owded {o-dade'} 或 `Oded {o-dade'}

源自 05749; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Oded 3; 3

俄德 = "復原者"
1) 猶大王亞撒時先知亞撒利雅的父親 (#代下 15:1,8|)
2) 比加入侵猶大時在撒瑪利亞的一位耶和華的先知 (#代下 28:9|)
record.edic_text:
05752 `Owded {o-dade'} or `Oded {o-dade'}

from 05749;; n pr m

AV - Oded 3; 3

Oded = "restorer"
1) father of Azariah the prophet in the reign of king Asa of Judah
2) a prophet of Jehovah in Samaria at the time of Pekah's invasion
   of Judah
